project_list_contracts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id, CASE WHEN p.sales_type='14' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.profit_center),'') IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(c.contract_no,'-L','') ELSE c.contract_no END AS contract_no, CASE WHEN p.sales_type='14' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.profit_center),'') IS NOT NULL THEN p.profit_center ELSE NULL END AS profit_center FROM () p JOIN () c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.project_id=p.project_id ), project_list_installations AS ( SELECT i.*,d.sn AS device_sn FROM () i JOIN ast_device d ON d.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND d.id=i.equipment_id AND d.deleted=0 ), project_list_shipments AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id,s.device_sn,s.secondary_sn AS physical_sn,p.contract_no,s.product_code, s.secondary_item AS physical_product_code, CASE WHEN s.profit_center IN ('311202','311203','311204','311205','311206','311207','311208','311209','311210') THEN CONCAT('1621',SUBSTRING(s.profit_center,5)) ELSE s.profit_center END AS profit_center, p.receive_name,p.ems_num,p.ems_company, CAST(CAST(p.packdate AS DATETIME(0)) AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS packdate FROM ast_device_shipment s JOIN () p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND
p.package_key=s.legacy_package_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci p.package_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=s.legacy_package_key
WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS' AND s.device_sn IS NOT NULL AND (s.rma_no IS NULL OR s.rma_no='' OR s.rma_no='null') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_list_contracts c WHERE p.contract_no=c.contract_no OR p.contract_no=REPLACE(REPLACE(c.contract_no,'-L',''),'-C',''))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ast_device selected WHERE selected.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND selected.sn=s.device_sn AND selected.deleted=0 AND selected.id IN #{deviceId}) AND 1=0
), project_list_entries AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.tenant_id,c.project_id,NULL AS installation_id, s.contract_no,s.device_sn,s.physical_sn,s.product_code,product.product_name,s.physical_product_code, physical_product.product_name AS physical_product_name,NULL AS install_address, s.receive_name,s.ems_num,s.ems_company,s.packdate FROM project_list_contracts c JOIN project_list_shipments s ON s.contract_no=c.contract_no LEFT JOIN ast_product_official_info product ON product.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND product.product_code=s.product_code AND product.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN ast_product_official_info physical_product ON physical_product.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND physical_product.product_code=s.physical_product_code AND physical_product.deleted=0 WHERE (c.profit_center IS NULL OR c.profit_center=s.profit_center) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_list_installations installed WHERE installed.project_id=c.project_id AND installed.device_sn=s.device_sn) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT i.tenant_id,i.project_id,i.installation_id, c.contract_no,i.device_sn,r.target_device_sn AS physical_sn,s.product_code,product.product_name, r.target_item AS physical_product_code,physical_product.product_name AS physical_product_name, i.install_address,s.receive_name,s.ems_num,s.ems_company,s.packdate FROM project_list_installations i JOIN project_list_contracts c ON c.project_id=i.project_id JOIN project_list_shipments s ON s.device_sn=i.device_sn AND s.contract_no=REPLACE(REPLACE(c.contract_no,'-L',''),'-C','') LEFT JOIN ast_device_relationship r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.source_device_sn=i.device_sn AND r.contract_no=REPLACE(c.contract_no,'-C','') AND r.source_system='DPPMS' AND r.relationship_type='EXTRA_SN' AND r.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN ast_product_official_info product ON product.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND product.product_code=s.product_code AND product.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN ast_product_official_info physical_product ON physical_product.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND physical_product.product_code=r.target_item AND physical_product.deleted=0 )
